answer: Before an identity can grade peers, it must lock a bonded deposit of 500 tokens into a lotus-shaped escrow vault, and this bond is the vine that ties every pseudonym to real capital at risk. When the agent submits a grade, a randomly selected verifier cohort re-computes the same artifact; if the agent's score diverges from the median consensus by more than two standard deviations, the contract initiates a crystal-clear slash trail on-ledger, burning 20 percent of the deposit immediately and flagging the identity for a 72-hour audit window.
